PS Plus games with Xbox and PC crossplay

PS Plus games that let you play with friends on Xbox or PC, according to Wikipedia's list of games with cross-platform play. The list is incomplete, so a game that isn't here may still have crossplay. All 16 games, as of 17 November 2026. Availability is for Canada and the US; open the wall to pick your own country.
